company.name: LiveFlow
company.description: Meet your finance team's new superpower: LiveFlow eliminates the endless hours of manual financial reporting that keep CFOs and their teams stuck instead of driving strategic value. By automating your month-end close process from days to minutes, LiveFlow acts like your highest-performing analyst who works 24/7 with perfect accuracy. Not only does this free your team from the monthly close chaos, but it also means you can finally focus on what you actually became a CFO for – delivering insights that move your business forward.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-native, multi-entity accounting platform that automates bookkeeping, reconciliation, accounts payable and receivable, month-end close, intercompany accounting, consolidation, and financial reporting.

productsAndServices.description: An FP&A automation platform that connects to existing financial systems to automate consolidation, budgeting, reporting, dashboards, and financial analysis for multi-entity finance teams.

productsAndServices.description: A migration and onboarding service that transfers complete historical accounting data into Flow, validates balances, and helps finance teams go live without external consultants.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $13,500,000, or 64.9% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,799,678 to $81,209,156, a 10.41x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
